subject: 6e8c09d4-c405-426e-b955-5f47e9b9ee63
object: French physicist known for theories of paramagnetism and diamagnetism and for pioneering ultrasonic submarine detection in WWI. Student of Pierre Curie; succeeded Lorentz as Solvay Conference president. An outspoken anti-fascist, placed under house arrest during the German occupation.
